connector.name: Bvcc Agent Wallet
connector.registryDescription: Non-custodial BVCC Agent Wallet on-chain for AI agents: balances, transfers, approvals, swaps.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.blockventurechaincapital. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Agent EOA private key (0x + 64 hex). Used locally to sign only; never transmitted.

env.name: WALLET_ADDRESS
env.description: The BVCC Agent Wallet address this agent operates (0x...).

env.name: CHAIN_ID
env.description: Default chain id: 42161 Arbitrum, 56 BNB Chain, 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 137 Polygon, 421614 Arbitrum Sepolia. Every tool also accepts an optional per-call network.

env.name: RPC_URL
env.description: Optional custom RPC for the default chain (comma-separated list allowed for failover). Public default used otherwise. Per-chain override via RPC_URL_<chainId>.

env.name: BVCC_MCP_READONLY
env.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read/simulate tools (no fund-moving writes).

env.name: BVCC_MCP_MODULES
env.description: Comma-separated capability modules to expose: core, aave. Unset exposes all.
